text: /* @component: .custom-swiper-indicator-uno */ (function() { function initIndicatorUnoSwiper() { const container = document.querySelector('.custom-swiper-indicator-uno'); if (!container) return; new Swiper('.custom-swiper-indicator-uno', { slidesPerView: 1, spaceBetween: 20, loop: false, navigation: { nextEl: '.custom-swiper-indicator-uno .custom-next-btn', prevEl: '.custom-swiper-indicator-uno .custom-prev-btn', disabledClass: 'is-disabled' }, pagination: { el: '.custom-swiper-indicator-uno .custom-pagination', type: 'fraction', renderFraction: function (currentClass, totalClass) { return ' / '; } } }); } if (!document.getElementById('swiper-css')) { const link = document.createElement('link'); link.id = 'swiper-css'; link.rel = 'stylesheet'; link.href = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.css'; document.head.appendChild(link); } if (typeof Swiper !== 'undefined') { initIndicatorUnoSwiper(); } else { let script = document.getElementById('swiper-js'); if (!script) { script = document.createElement('script'); script.id = 'swiper-js'; script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js'; document.head.appendChild(script); } script.addEventListener('load', initIndicatorUnoSwiper); } })();
